description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_Dxy_dirichlet_bc (the mixed second derivative d^2u/dx dy with Dirichlet walls) driven by problems/anisotropic_diffusion_2d_dirichlet.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding of NX=NY together (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) - no per-resolution fixture files. The bare cross operator is symmetric indefinite and would blow up under time integration, so the MMS embeds it in the positive-definite anisotropic diffusion tensor K=[[1,1/2],[1/2,1]]: the combined operator D(D(u,x),x)+D(D(u,x),y)+D(D(u,y),y) (central_D2x_dirichlet_bc + central_Dxy_dirichlet_bc + central_D2y_dirichlet_bc) is negative definite and dissipative (the Dirichlet boundary flux vanishes). The manufactured steady solution sin(pi x) sin(pi y) vanishes on all four walls and is held by the exactly matching analytic forcing; the drift at t=0.1 is the pure O(h^2) truncation of the anisotropic operator, whose cross-derivative half is the rule under test, so a bug in central_Dxy_dirichlet_bc corrupts the recorded L2/Linf errors and the order.
